rules_satisfied: No production unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable, or assert macros
No unchecked indexing - replaced parts[1] with split_once
No split+collect+indexing - replaced with split_once for first-delimiter extraction
No unchecked arithmetic - total accumulation uses checked_add with Overflow error
No unchecked division - count checked > 0 before division
No lossy as conversions - usize to u64 is never lossy on any platform
No Vec allocation for line parsing - single split_once instead of split+collect
Return type matches tests - Result<Summary, SummaryError> instead of Result<String, SummaryError>
render_summary function added as pure formatting shell
Functional core: summarize_metrics is pure and deterministic, render_summary is pure formatting
Empty input handled - returns Empty error when no valid lines parsed
Invalid format handled - returns Invalid error on missing delimiter or bad parse
Overflow detected - checked_add returns Overflow on u64 overflow
TooMany constraint enforced - returns error when count exceeds max_rows
Tests are the immutable behavior contract - no test files modified
